status: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-10-21 before v2 rendering or candidate comparisons
walking_height_basis: ASSUMED conservative camera-operator envelope, not an architectural standard
motion_basis: ASSUMED slow walkthrough camera operation; no published speed or yaw standard claimed

sample_difference.basis: ASSUMED image fidelity criterion, registered before measurements
sample_difference.metric: mean absolute RGB channel error in developed 8-bit PNG divided by 255, same camera, seed, exposure, white balance, full 1920x1080 frame
sample_difference.requirement: all three representative frames also pass unmodified render_qa

temporal_difference.basis: ASSUMED temporal noise criterion, registered before measurements
temporal_difference.metric: mean absolute RGB change between adjacent candidate frames on static opaque high-roughness surfaces reprojected using measured world position and first-hit position agreement within 0.03 m; reject disocclusion, four-pixel borders, depth edges, glass, emissive and unmatched pixels; RGB divided by 255; includes real view-dependent changes conservatively
temporal_difference.registration_revision: 2026-10-15 before any walkthrough image rendering or measurement: use actual reprojected candidate changes, avoiding an unnecessary 1024-sample reference for every final frame; threshold unchanged at 0.01
temporal_difference.coverage: every adjacent frame pair; insufficient valid static pixels refuses acceptance

exposure_scope: all 2250 path frames; one complete-clip source population and one upper-median meter lock; no still-view lock reuse
final_gate: ~/archpipe/logs/render/finals.done must exist before final GPU work

motion_blur.basis: ASSUMED 180-degree cinematography convention; 0.5 frame exposure at 30 frames per second; real Cycles camera transforms, no post blur

sample_temporal_pairs: Registered deterministically before any image measurement: peak travel pair, peak yaw pair, first garden-subject pair; each candidate must pass static temporal and speckle gates as well as three-frame reference error
encoding_comparison: Every decoded web frame against native final PNG; registered pixel error threshold and 15000000-byte ceiling in speckle policy

pixel_filter.basis: ASSUMED native pixel reconstruction support; source metering retains measured v1 default. Fixed geometry/normals/materials/camera counterfactuals precede integration; 3.0 rejected for softness, preregistered2.0 failed speckle,2.5 passed and independent full-size review supports diagnostic integration. Speckle/fidelity thresholds unchanged.
pixel_filter.source: https://docs.blender.org/manual/en/4.0/render/cycles/render_settings/film.html (qualitative mechanism only); pinned4.5.14 native API/readback and actual edge experiments

camera_motion_check.registration: 2026-10-22 before quaternion construction correction or replacement readback
camera_motion_check.basis: ASSUMED native numerical agreement screen, not cinematographic/image acceptance; original speed, yaw and image limits unchanged
camera_motion_check.coverage: Every frame, actual evaluated camera forward direction at five fractions of the centered shutter versus independent analytic path yaw; disable no production checks
